messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] proxy-auth-service: sudden spike in 429/403 from multiple client IPs; sample trace indicates repeated token validation failures. Auto-threshold triggered at 1837654310. Suggested severity: P1.

Matt S.: just woke up to this, looking now. first thought: replay/credential stuffing?

Rachel L.: I can jump on logs and envs, paging Jordan for sec triage. @Jordan (sec_oncall) can you take? :eyes: 

Jordan (sec_oncall): on it. pulling auth logs. any known deploys in last hour?

Eve (eng): no deploys in last 2h from CI, checked deploy-bot. infra looks stable.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: no active deploys in last 4h. autoscale events normal.

Matt S.: sample traces show same client token being validated then failing 429/403 intermittently, then succeeding. looks like brute force attempts with many short-lived tokens?

Jordan (sec_oncall): grabbing token audit. running quick query against auth-store: 
```
SELECT token_id, created_at, last_seen_ip FROM auth.tokens WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours' ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 50;
```

Jordan (sec_oncall): result: ~120 tokens created from 3 /16 ranges in last 90 min; many tokens associated with the same user-agents. suspicious.

Priya (CS): any customer-visible errors yet? I'm seeing two support threads referencing 401s from our SDK.

Rachel L.: Metrics: frontend 5xx increase ~2.3x, proxy 429s up 18x. Customer-facing error pages minimal so far, but SDK retries could surface. start incident page?

Matt S.: yes. I started the incident doc: https://intranet.redwood/incident/INC-1837654321 (skeleton). Assigning IC. I can be IC until further notice.

Jordan (sec_oncall): priority actions: 1) Isolate token creation endpoint (rate-limit + block offending subnets), 2) rotate any short-lived service credentials that may be abused, 3) revoke tokens created in window if malware suspected.

Eve (eng): on rate-limit patch, pushing a temporary policy to proxy-config: 
```
# temp rate-limit
rate_limit:
  auth_create: 5/min per IP
  global_create: 200/min
```
Pushing now to staging then prod canary.

infra-bot: canary deploy of proxy-config to prod-canary initiated by Eve at 1837654375.

Rachel L.: Jordan, can you confirm if leaked logs contain tokens? I ran quick grep in kinesis sink and saw few full tokens in debug lines earlier this morning.

Jordan (sec_oncall): confirmed. Debug logs from a worker included Authorization: Bearer <token> for a handful of requests. Looks like we had verbose logging enabled in a background job for ~30m earlier.

Matt S.: that's bad. we need immediate key/token rotation for impacted customers and rotate any service credentials used by that worker. Also remove debug logs and trigger a log purge where possible.

Jordan (sec_oncall): running log-redact job for affected streams: 
```
# redact tokens from kinesis/S3
python infra/tools/redact_logs.py --stream auth-debug --pattern 'Bearer [A-Za-z0-9\-\._]+' --start '2025-11-22T09:00Z' --end '2025-11-22T09:30Z'
```
Launched at 1837654410.

Priya (CS): preparing customer outreach draft for impacted SDK users — low-latency 401s, recommend rotating client keys. Will wait for security wording.

Eve (eng): prod-canary rate-limit live. Initial 10 min telemetry looks good, 429s dropped 60% for offending IPs.

Jordan (sec_oncall): next: revoke tokens created from suspicious IP ranges. Use token-revocation playbook. Exec: 
```
# revoke tokens by query
./scripts/revoke_tokens.sh --created-after "2025-11-22T08:30Z" --ip-prefixes "203.0.113.0/24,198.51.100.0/24,192.0.2.0/24"
```
Running now (started 1837654480). Will throttle to avoid mass customer impact.

Matt S.: also rotate the worker's service role creds (STP creds). Jordan, can you confirm the ARN?

Jordan (sec_oncall): worker role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/auth-debug-worker. Initiating key rotation via KMS/HSM flow.

infra-bot: rotation job started for role auth-debug-worker at 1837654515. Old keys scheduled for immediate disable, 1h grace for rollouts.

Rachel L.: Priya, once we have list of revoked tokens count, we'll decide on outreach and whether to notify specific customers. Also customer-facing SLO may be impacted for any clients losing sessions.

Priya (CS): understood. drafting targeted message: "We've revoked affected tokens as a precaution and rotated credentials for the debug worker. If you see login issues, please follow the outlined steps..." Will post when approved.

Eve (eng): quick check: does Canary config fully cut off token creation from suspect subnets? Might still see retries from proxied NAT. We should also add temporary WAF block of the offending /24s.

Jordan (sec_oncall): agreed. raising WAF block now.

incident-bot: WAF rule applied: block ip-ranges [203.0.113.0/24,198.51.100.0/24,192.0.2.0/24] at 1837654540.

Matt S.: good. summary for handoff in 30m: IC Matt S., SEC Jordan, ENG Eve, CS Priya. Primary mitigations: rate-limits + canary config, token revocation in progress (~started 1837654480), service-role key rotation started, log-redact job running. Customer impact: some SDK users may see 401s until tokens are reissued; targeted outreach ready.

Jordan (sec_oncall): tally so far: ~120 tokens revoked, 3 suspect subnets blocked, one worker role rotated. No evidence yet of exfil beyond logs containing tokens; redact job in progress.

Priya (CS): received approval for customer note. Will wait for final counts then send early advisory to affected customers.

Rachel L.: creating postmortem doc and capturing timeline. Adding runbook links and commands used.

Eve (eng): prod metrics continue to normalize. No further suspicious IPs appearing after WAF block.

Matt S.: I need to hand this off. My pager window ends. @Rachel L. can you IC from here? I'll do a quick summary for the next oncall.

Rachel L.: I can take IC. Thanks Matt. Handoff summary:
- what happened: spike in token creation + debug logs leaked tokens -> token misuse attempts -> elevated 429/403 and SDK 401s for some customers.
- actions taken: applied stricter rate-limits, blocked offending subnets at WAF, revoked ~120 tokens, rotated worker service creds, redacted logs, started customer outreach draft.
- open items: confirm full redact completion, confirm if any long-lived tokens leaked and rotate if needed, formal customer notice and postmortem.

Matt S.: extra note for follow-up: audit S3 lifecycle retention and ensure archived debug dumps are checked. Also add ephemeral debug gating to deploy checklist.

Jordan (sec_oncall): leaving note: create detection rule to alert on token patterns in debug logs and prevent verbose auth logging in prod jobs.

Rachel L.: I'll coordinate next steps with SRE and Security for timeline. Handoff timestamp: 1837654620.

Eve (eng): tagging the config PR for permanent rate-limit tweaks.

Priya (CS): I'll send initial advisory to impacted customers after final count.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity downgraded to P2 at 1837654600. Monitoring continues.

Rachel L.: OK team — I'll keep this as active until redact and rotation confirm. Assigning follow-ups in the incident doc. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
